title: Norm of the generalized Hilbert operator on weighted Bergman spaces
summary: Several upper bounds as well as one lower bound for the operator norm of the generalized Hilbert operator $\mathcal{H}_b$ acting on weighted Bergman spaces $A_α^p$ are established. Moreover, under some mild assumptions, we obtain the exact norm of $\mathcal{H}_b$ on $ A_α^p$.
